finding.behavior: Changes to ftCo_MS_DeadDown, sets three flags, clears two item pointers, and, for Fox, creates a thumb-attached blaster and scales it. Its complete body contains none of the death-cleanup, fall/stock accounting, or blast-effect sequence present in ftCo_800D3BC8.
finding.rationale: The prop-setup qualifier describes the observable initialization and distinguishes it from gameplay death entry without claiming an unverified menu or cinematic purpose.
finding.uncertainty: External callers of this function were not located in the inspected sources, so its higher-level use remains unresolved. Props are character-conditional; the name does not imply that every fighter receives a prop.

finding.behavior: Changes to ftCo_MS_DeadRight and applies the shared flag/item-pointer initialization. Fox receives a scaled thumb-attached blaster. Dr. Mario receives two separately created, scaled vitamin items stored in the two item fields. Other kinds receive no additional setup in this switch.
finding.rationale: The conditional prop initialization is directly supported by the complete body and inline helpers. The qualifier separates this routine from blast-zone death entry without inventing its external use.
finding.uncertainty: External callers were not located in the inspected sources. A more specific presentation, results-screen, or other mode-based name would require caller evidence.
